verified: Binance said on Thursday that its withdrawal recovery work is complete and that it has lifted the withdrawal suspension, following a hack last month in which a record $6.3 billion was stolen, Reuters reported.
unconfirmed: how much of the $6.3 billion has been recovered, whether customer funds were fully covered, what caused the breach and what security changes followed — the report does not address these, and the figures rest on Binance's own statement.

verified: 据路透社报道，币安表示其提币恢复工作已完成，并已解除上个月黑客攻击后实施的提币暂停；该报道称被盗金额为 63 亿美元，创下纪录。
unconfirmed: 63 亿美元是否已被追回或全额补偿、储备是否已恢复到攻击前水平、提币功能是否已在所有用户和所有币种上恢复，均无独立审计或第三方核实；攻击的具体入侵方式与确切发生日期，报道亦未交代。

titles.en: Binance lifts withdrawal suspension after record $6.3B hack
titles.zh: 币安称已完成恢复工作，全面解除提币暂停，此前被盗 63 亿美元
